SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.2. Special Branch.
REPORT
Date May 11, 1933.
Subject (in full) Inquiries regarding L.F.G. Mirabel (French).
Made by D.S. Tilton. Forwarded by [签名]
With reference to the attached letter from the
Netherlands Consulate regarding L.F.G. Mirabel, from inquiries
made it was ascertained that he arrived in Shanghai by the
S.S. 'Porthos' from Singapore as a 3rd class passenger on
March 3, together with a female named Yvonne Neryvof, a
Belgian subject. L.F.G. Mirabel declared that he is a
violinist while his companion is a professional dancer,
their object in visiting Shanghai was to give a number of
recitals and they originally sailed together from Marseilles.
These persons were eventually traced as having resided together
as Mr. and Mrs. Mirabel at the Embassy Hotel, No.7 Carter Road,
until March 24 when they left the hotel with their baggage
at about 12 noon and did not leave a forwarding address.
From an interrogation of the room 'Boy' it was learned that
they intended shortly to leave Shanghai; he also heard
Yvonne Neryvof talking over the telephone to Mirabel on
March 24 when she inquired as to the time of the departure
of a ship.
Further inquiries were made at the regular passenger
shipping lines in the Settlement for these persons who were
thus suspected to have left Shanghai on March 24 or 25, without
result. These inquiries were continued and later revealed
that they booked separate passages on the S.S. 'Aramis',
Messageries Maritimes, 9-10 French Bund, and sailed from
Shanghai on March 25 for Hongkong. Yvonne Neryvof stated at
the shipping office that she desired to remain in Hongkong for
a short period only, so she booked her reservation through to
Singapore.
Officer i/c Special Branch.
[签名]
D. S.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
S.2. 特别支部。
报告
日期：1933年5月11日。
事由（全称）：关于L.F.G. Mirabel（法国人）的调查。
由D.S. Tilton制作。呈送者 [签名]
兹就附上的荷兰领事馆关于L.F.G. Mirabel的来信，经查询查明，他于3月3日作为三等舱乘客，与一名名为Yvonne Neryvof的比利时籍女子一同乘“Porthos”号轮船从新加坡抵达上海。L.F.G. Mirabel自称是小提琴家，其同伴是职业舞蹈演员，他们来沪的目的是举行数次独奏会，两人最初是一同从马赛启航的。经查，这些人最终以Mirabel夫妇的名义共同居住在卡特路7号使馆酒店（Embassy Hotel），直至3月24日中午12时左右携带行李离开酒店，且未留下转寄地址。经讯问该房间的服务员（Boy）得知，他们打算不久后离开上海；他还听到Yvonne Neryvof在3月24日通过电话向Mirabel询问船只的离港时间。
随后在租界内的常规客运轮船公司对这些疑似于3月24日或25日离沪的人员进行了查询，但未获结果。这些查询工作继续进行，后来查明他们在法商东方汇理银行码头9-10号的法国邮船公司（Messageries Maritimes）预订了“阿拉米斯”号（S.S. 'Aramis'）轮船的分开的舱位，并于3月25日从上海启航前往香港。Yvonne Neryvof在轮船公司办事处表示，她只希望在香港短暂停留，因此她将预订一直订到新加坡。
特别支部主管警官。
[签名]
D. S.

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.

No. 1181.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. R. REGISTRY
D 4808
27-4-1933
SHANGHAI. 26-4-1933.

Sir,

I should be much obliged to obtain,
if possible, the address of Mr. L. F. G.
Mirabel, a musician, formerly employed
with the Cercle Artistique at Soera-
baja, who is supposed to be living
at present in Shanghai.

I am also writing to the French
Police.

Thanking you in anticipation of
your kind assistance in this matter,

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

T. P. Givens, Esquire,
Officer i/c Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,

Chinese Secretary.

SHANGHAI.

Sd. For inquiry and
report please.
D. S. Tilch. 27/4
APR. 27 1933

荷兰驻华中总领事馆

第1181号。

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事登记处
D 4808
1933年4月27日
上海。1933年4月26日。

先生：

如能获悉前曾在泗水（Soerabaja）艺术圈（Cercle Artistique）任职的音乐家L. F. G. Mirabel先生的地址，本人将不胜感激，据信他目前居住在上海。

本人亦致函法国警方。

预先感谢阁下在此事上给予的善意协助，

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

T. P. Givens 先生，
上海公共租界工部局警务处特别支部主管警官，

华务秘书。

上海。

签注：请调查并具报。
D. S. Tilch. 4月27日
1933年4月27日

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
No. D H 808
Date 12 / 5 / 33

May 11 33

Dear Van den Berg,

With reference to your letter No.1181
dated April 26, 1933, I forward herewith for
your information a copy of a report made by
Detective Sergeant Tilton of the Special Branch
on the subject of Mr. L.F.G. Mirabel.

Yours sincerely,

J. Van den Berg, Esq.,
Netherlands Consulate-General,
Shanghai.
